name: Arrakis V1
rootCause: Uniswap V3 spot-price manipulation of vault mint/burn. Lost: ~2.9414 ETH net attacker surplus (Arrakis V1 / G-UNI ENS-WETH vault)

descriptions.text: Uniswap V3 spot-price manipulation of vault mint/burn. Lost: ~2.9414 ETH net attacker surplus (Arrakis V1 / G-UNI ENS-WETH vault)

On August 23, 2026, the Arrakis V1 / G-UNI ENS–WETH liquidity-manager vault (0x7c687f775a3b73bbab0e15832f24caab5d53bdde) was drained via Uniswap V3 spot-price manipulation. The attacker flash-loaned 1,800 WETH from Morpho Blue, skewed the pool’s instantaneous spot price, minted vault shares at the distorted valuation, restored the price, and burned the shares for a richer token mix, netting ≈2.94 WETH. Root cause: mint()/burn() valued the Uniswap V3 position off pool.slot0() with no TWAP or deviation guard (TWAP only protected rebalance()).

Arrakis V1's ENS,WETH Uniswap V3 vault on Ethereum was exploited on 23 August 2026 via a spot price manipulation, allowing an attacker to profit 2.94 WETH (~$7,100) in a single flash-loan-enabled transaction by distorting vault share pricing. The ArrakisVaultV1 contract's mint() and burn() functions valued deposits and withdrawals using the live Uniswap V3 slot0() spot price. No time-weighted average price (TWAP) or deviation checks protected these operations, enabling an attacker to move the pool price within one transaction and capture manipulated value.
